Hi Sophie — great to meet you and the Moneta team on the call. Below is a concise technical note that addresses each item and outlines concrete next steps. Attaching a short PDF note for your engineering and procurement teams.

1) API auth options (summary)
- Short-lived API keys: issue via Redwood console with TTLs (recommended for mobile clients paired with an app-side exchange).
- OAuth/JWT: support for customer-managed issuer (OIDC) or Redwood-managed tokens; we can validate inbound JWTs and mint short-lived session tokens for downstream requests.
- Service account model: recommended for server-to-server batch jobs — service accounts with scoped roles and rotating key material.

Rotation and audit
- Default rotation cadence: 90-day rotation for long-lived keys; recommended 24-hour TTL for session tokens.
- We publish key rotation events to audit logs and can push them to a customer-managed logging endpoint or S3.

2) Routing & regional pinning
- Route policy: you can pin traffic to region (us-west/us-east/eu) and configure fallback policies to a compatible model variant in another region. We expose per-route config in the SDK and via the Console.

3) Structured output & tool-calls
- Tool-call enforcement: Redwood can validate structured outputs against a supplied JSON schema at inference time and emit structured traces to your observability endpoint.
- Tool-call logs include call payloads (optionally redacted) and timing metrics.

4) Embeddings & rerankers
- Storage: embeddings can be stored encrypted at rest in customer-managed buckets or in Redwood-managed encrypted storage.
- Rerankers: we support both Redwood-hosted rerank (managed) and local rerank via SDK (we provide the model weights and a small runtime shim) depending on latency and control needs.

Action items / next steps
- Evelyn: prepare 1–2 page technical note (attached) + example SDK snippet for service-account token exchange (EOD Wed).
- Karthik: prepare a baseline MAP (mutual action plan) with timelines and procurement milestones (ETA Fri).
- Sophie: share procurement contact & any required SOC2 evidence checklist.

Attachments: redwood_integration_notes.pdf

If helpful, we can set a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through the SDK snippet and the key rotation flow.

Best,
